correctness.rationale: Over GF(2), the hypercube A satisfies A^2=(d mod 2)I. The square-zero N=A+(d mod2)I has rank 2^(d-1), by the invertible linear substitution in its group algebra. The four vectors e_u,e_v,Ae_u,Ae_v are independent for d>=3 and span an invariant local space. Direct 4x4 calculation gives C((z^2+z+1)^2) in even adjacent and two C(z^2+z+1) blocks in odd nonadjacent; invariant orthogonal complements retain J2 blocks. In even nonadjacent and odd adjacent cases the explicitly computed power-rank sequences fix J3(0)^2 and J4(1), respectively, with multiplicities in RESULT.md. Fitting splitting yields exact first-periodic-entry shells and Möbius-inverted orbit counts. Independent GF2 full adjacency matrices for d=3,4,5 and each Hamming-distance class reproduced all five-step rank sequences (12 cases). Finite cases check, but do not prove, the all-d theorem.
residual_risks: The d=2 excluded case has dependent local neighborhood columns; no classification there.
Only binary arithmetic, not odd-characteristic analogue; finite ranks alone cannot establish the infinite family.
